scope: Isolated source-level regression tests with mocks. No deployed-app, Docker, database, or full type-check verification.

tests.name: CORS default denies untrusted origin and disables credentials
CORS exact allowlist preserves trusted credentialed clients
CORS refuses wildcard credentials including dynamic origins
CORS rejects null, absent and missing-config origins
Default SQLite requires no SQL password
SQL password required; configured host and port honored
SQL port bounds reject invalid values
Changed SQL templates permit SQLite and reject missing SQL passwords
Changed secret-bearing admin configs reject missing secrets
Changed server configs use loopback and require strong app keys
GraphQL production defaults bound depth and pagination; disable batching/introspection
URL import denies private, metadata, unspecified, CGNAT and mapped IPv4 destinations
URL import rejects any private address in a mixed DNS answer
URL import passes redirect:error to fetch and rejects non-HTTP protocols
Logout fails visibly when server-side revocation throws
Logout succeeds only when mocked revocation completes
Reset rejects missing, expired, boundary and invalid expiry without changing password
Reset accepts valid link and clears token and expiry
Changed JS/TS files parse (syntax only, not typecheck)
